results.summary: The director keeps a Gold balance that starts at 0 and prints it in the status lines. It spawns a gold purse at the barracks node. E adds 100 gold once, and the purse is destroyed and guarded by bPurseTaken. This is verified by reading only; I did not build or run the game.

evidence.note: Spawn at barracks node, in the director's floor-build code.
HandleInteract does Gold += PurseGold once (guarded by bPurseTaken) and destroys the purse.
GetStatusLines adds the gold balance to the status text.
The E key (InteractAction) reaches the interactable, which routes to the director.
static constexpr 100, commented as a demo value (crew EXPERIMENTAL, not approved design).

results.score_reason: GDD line 319 and the HUD lines 395-397 make gold the currency; the toll cannot be paid without it. The code is already in place, so building priority is low now, but TOLL-02 depended on it. I did not confirm the HUD draws the status lines, and build and play are unverified.

results.summary: A Boss interactable is spawned at boss_room. On E at the threatening stage it shows bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01 with {adventurer_name} replaced by the generic word 'adventurer' and {toll_amount} filled from toll_gold of the threatening stage in faction_stages.json. A second message tells the player to press Q to pay. The strings and stage files exist in the plugin's Content/Data folder. The runtime parse of the CSV and JSON is unverified because the game was not run.

evidence.note: Spawned at boss_room after LoadBanditData().
HandleInteract Boss case (E, not paid) shows the line, then 'Press Q facing the boss to pay the toll'.
Parses the CSV and reads toll_gold for the 'threatening' stage. BossLine fills the placeholders.
The data file is present where DDText::LoadDataFile looks for it.

results.score_reason: GDD lines 385-387 make the toll demand the core of the boss encounter, and TOLL-02 builds on it. It is already in code, so little remains to build. The adventurer-name fallback is a demo substitute, and runtime behaviour is unverified.

results.summary: Q on the boss runs the pay branch. With Gold >= TollGold it subtracts exactly TollGold, sets bTollPaid, shows bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 and the log line, and changes no faction favor. With less gold it shows bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 and takes nothing. After the toll is paid, Q never charges again. Not built or run. Two gaps to note: (1) the cannot-pay line leaves {toll_amount} filled through BossLine, which I did not confirm; (2) bTollPaid is a director member, so it holds for the run.

evidence.note: Pay branch in HandleInteract Boss case, guarded by bAlt and the bTollPaid check, so a second payment is impossible.
Insufficient-gold branch changes no state.
Q (AltAction) calls Target->Interact(true), which reaches the director.
Per-run flag; the header comment says the descent reads it, but no descent code reads it yet.

results.score_reason: GDD lines 385-390 and crew rule TOLL-03 make paying the central action of the milestone. DD-DESC-01 depends on bTollPaid. It is already in code, so the remaining work is verification by building and playing.

results.summary: No descent interactable exists. The EDDDemoKind enum has no Descent kind, nothing spawns an object at the descent node, and no code shows a barred message, a win banner or an end-of-demo state. The only reference is a header comment on bTollPaid saying a descent will read it. The boss's 'Go on down' line points the player at something that does nothing.

evidence.note: Comment 'Read by the descent in DD-DESC-01' is the only mention of a descent. No reader exists.
The EDDDemoKind enum ends at Boss with no Descent kind.
Searched Source/ case-insensitively for 'descent', 'win', 'demo over', 'barred'; found only the header comment above.

results.score_reason: GDD lines 44-45 and 390 make going down the descent the win condition, and the milestone cannot be played to its end without it. It is the only missing requirement, with dependencies GOLD-01, TOLL-01 and TOLL-02 already implemented, so it is ready to build. Nothing else depends on it.
